vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component serves as a foundational declaration file defining the TypeScript interfaces for interoperability between JavaScript and a WebAssembly-compiled .NET runtime. It establishes contracts for managed types like MonoObject, MonoString, and WasmRoot, acting as a crucial bridge layer. It exposes deprecated APIs, such as BINDINGType and MONOType, which handle low-level memory access and runtime configuration. The file is purely declarative, defining the structure of the runtime contract without implementing executable logic.
